newsitem.title: UK: IEA sees OPEC unchanged at 26.98 mbpd in February.
newsitem.headline: IEA sees OPEC unchanged at 26.98 mbpd in February.

text.p: OPEC crude oil output in February was unchanged from January at 26.98 million barrels per day (bpd), the International Energy Agency (IEA) estimated on Friday.

The agency, in its monthly oil market report, said it had detected declines in Libya and Algeria offsetting increases in Indonesia, Venezuela and the neutral zone, shared between Saudi Arabia and Kuwait.
The IEA said market resistance to Iraqi exports into the oversupplied Mediterranean kept a lid on Iraq output at 1.07 million bpd, from 1.08 million in January.
Major OPEC producers Saudi Arabia and Iran were little changed at 8.265 million and 3.7 million respectively.
Nigeria kept output at a high for the country of 2.27 million bpd. Venezuela moved up to 3.12 million.
Libya slipped 50,000 bpd to 1.38 million and Algeria by 10,000 bpd to 850,000 bpd.
